hotel.name: Hotel Pietra di Luna
room_features: Walking distance to the beach and Maiori's main promenade

days.title: Arrival to the Amalfi Coast
days.summary: Airport welcome, private coastal transfer to Maiori, hotel check-in, welcome cocktail and welcome dinner.

activities.title: Arrival Window — Naples International Airport
activities.description: Guests arrive into Naples International Airport within the arrival window. Host waiting outside the airport with a private transfer and a Tocca Amalfi Coast sign.

activities.title: Private Coastal Transfer to Maiori
activities.description: Scenic drive from Naples through the coast countryside and mountain landscapes toward the Amalfi Coast.

activities.title: Hotel Check-In — Pietra di Luna, Maiori
activities.description: Check-in at Hotel Pietra di Luna. Passport required. Free time to relax, refresh and enjoy the sea breeze.
activities.notes: Passport in hand required at check-in.

activities.title: Welcome Cocktail
activities.description: Official Tocca Amalfi Coast Welcome Cocktail on the hotel terrace main floor.
activities.location: Hotel Pietra di Luna — main floor terrace

activities.title: Welcome Dinner in Maiori
activities.description: Relaxed, authentic welcome dinner along Maiori's main corso, introducing guests to the flavors of the Amalfi Coast.

days.title: Slow Morning & Lemon Trail Experience
days.summary: Relaxed morning in Maiori, afternoon Maiori–Minori lemon path walk, lemon property visit, and a lemon-inspired dinner.

activities.title: Relaxed Morning in Maiori
activities.description: Free morning to sleep in and recharge, enjoy the beach in front of the hotel, explore Maiori, or walk the promenade.

activities.title: Afternoon Gathering
activities.description: Meet in the lobby of Hotel Pietra di Luna before the lemon path experience.

activities.title: Maiori to Minori Lemon Path
activities.description: Scenic walk connecting Maiori and Minori through lemon groves, hidden pathways, coastline views, Maiori's church and historic center, and the local corso.

activities.title: The Lemon Trail Experience
activities.description: Welcome at a generational lemon property near Minori. Learn about Amalfi Coast lemon cultivation, family traditions, local products and craftsmanship.

activities.title: Lemon-Inspired Dinner
activities.description: A lemon-inspired dinner highlighting the flavors and traditions of Amalfi lemons. Soft, relaxed and deeply local evening.

days.title: Positano, Conca dei Marini, Praiano & Ceramic Heritage
days.summary: Afternoon transfer toward Positano with a ceramic atelier stop in Conca dei Marini, free time in Positano, and dinner overlooking the Positano panorama.

activities.title: Departure for Positano
activities.description: Private transfer begins the afternoon journey toward Positano.

activities.title: Stop in Conca dei Marini — Amalfi Coast Ceramics
activities.description: Visit to an emblematic ceramic atelier. Explore ceramic collections, learn the history and artistry of Amalfi ceramics, and shop if desired.

activities.title: Scenic Coastal Drive to Positano
activities.description: One of the most breathtaking drives along the Amalfi Coast before arriving in Positano.

activities.title: Free Time in Positano
activities.description: Independent exploration of Positano with host guidance on shopping, viewpoints, boutiques, cafés, beaches, and meeting points/timing.

activities.title: Dinner in Positano
activities.description: Dinner overlooking the Positano panorama. Guests choose their courses in advance from the set menu below (standard or vegetarian).

days.title: Amalfi, Atrani & Pizza Experience
days.summary: Afternoon ferry to Amalfi, exploring Amalfi and Atrani on foot, and a hands-on pizza & mozzarella cooking experience before returning to Maiori.

activities.title: Afternoon Ferry to Amalfi
activities.description: Meet at the port of Maiori and board the ferry together toward Amalfi, with coastline views from the sea.

activities.title: Exploring Amalfi Together
activities.description: Explore Amalfi's historic center, the famous cathedral and piazza, local boutiques and artisan shops, hidden streets, and time for gelato or coffee.

activities.title: Walk to Atrani
activities.description: Scenic walk connecting Amalfi and Atrani, the smallest village in Italy — quieter and more intimate side of the coast.

activities.title: Private Transfer from Atrani
activities.description: Private transfer meets guests in Atrani to bring them to the pizza and mozzarella experience.

activities.title: Pizza & Mozzarella Cooking Experience
activities.description: Hands-on cooking class: traditional pizza-making techniques and fresh mozzarella preparation. The pizza and mozzarella experience is dinner for the evening.

activities.title: Return to Maiori
activities.description: Private transfer returns guests to Maiori for the evening.
